## Workload

Elif Sahin graded 461 sets during 412 rostered hours. This represents an average throughput of 1.1 sets per hour. The workload was completed within the scheduled hours, with the grading activity reviewed as part of the routine assessment process.

## Quality

A sample of 45 graded sets was read again by the reviewer. The recorded agreement was 80.0 per cent. The results provide a basis for continuing the current session pattern and maintaining the existing approach to grading.

The review was completed by Priya Anand.
